mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-heading-classification.test.ts:direct Heading1 through Heading9 classify by identifier without changing package bytes
outcomes: Nine exact Heading1 through Heading9 identifiers read the matching level and true flag without changing bytes or paragraph text.
gaps: Native loop covers the bounded direct-ID policy; no shared case execution, saved output or wider Go prefix/outline semantics.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-heading-classification.test.ts:absent ordinary and misleading style IDs do not infer a heading
outcomes: Absent style and ten ordinary or misleading identifiers read false and zero; bytes remain unchanged.
gaps: Bun absent style returns undefined rather than the shared empty-string result; this is not the literal shared setter/getter profile.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-heading-classification.test.ts:direct style classification does not compute base-style outline or body-anchor semantics
outcomes: Direct style classification ignores base-style and outline values; existing body-anchor classification follows direct outline independently.
gaps: Only two explicit outline states and one base-style chain are checked; no general inherited outline computation.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-heading-classification.test.ts:style classification survives path save reopen without changing text or unrelated members
outcomes: Path save and reopen retain Heading9 level, flag, style, paragraph text and every package member payload.
gaps: Only Heading9 is path-reopened here; no independent renderer or other consumer execution.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-heading-classification.test.ts:changed or externally modified paragraph handles refuse classification instead of serving cached headings
outcomes: Locally invalidated and externally modified paragraph snapshots refuse both heading getters without changing bytes.
gaps: No concurrency or arbitrary external package edits are checked; refusal conditions are the stated stale snapshots.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-heading-classification.test.ts:classification reads literal imported IDs without requiring style definitions but refuses ambiguous direct metadata
outcomes: An imported Heading3 ID reads without a style registry; duplicate and misqualified direct style metadata refuse without byte changes.
gaps: Only two malformed metadata variants; no styles-part semantic validation, rendering or general XML admission claim.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-heading-classification.test.ts:aliased UTF16 direct style reads without editing encoding or root namespace bindings
outcomes: Aliased UTF-16 direct Heading2 reads its level and flag without editing the complete archive.
gaps: Only UTF-16LE and one namespace alias; no multi-encoding exhaustive proof or path save in this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-heading-classification.test.ts:empty style retains strict Bun policy and all five shared getter-profile cases stay planned
outcomes: Empty string assignment refuses; null removes style and reads undefined/false/zero; all five shared getter cases remain planned and acceptance totals are unchanged.
gaps: Inventory presence and planned status confer no execution credit; the five-case profile cannot be selected while the empty-string API differs.
